g.title: apartment_and_f
g.text: 760 vertices: H(3) with 32 flags subdivided, F a 16-cycle on one flag orbit and two 8-cycles on the other

g.title: titleA
g.text: one apartment of H(3) through two of the 32 flags

g.title: legendA
g.text: discs: points, squares: lines, grey: the other two lines through a point
and the other two points on a line; blue: new vertices and edges of F

g.title: titleF
g.text: the 32 new vertices and the 32 edges of F

g.title: legendF
g.text: no edge of F joins A to B: H(3) with A and its cycle, and H(3) with B and its two cycles,
